messages:
incident-bot: PAGE @oncall-ml @oncall-sre :rotating_light: Smart-routing policy runtime panic detected in europe-prod. Incident INC-2026-319. Symptoms: policy evaluation panics -> fallback loop across regions, elevated 5xxs and latency for customers routed to EU. Start ts: 2026-03-15T09:21:18Z. Please ack and triage.

alice (oncall-ml): ack, taking. I'm looking. Any immediate customer-visible impact numbers?

maria (eng-runtime): seeing spikes in 'policy-eval' errors right at 09:20:30. The policy that landed in prod from PR #482 has an expression that throws on some routing inputs. Quick log sample:```
policy-eval error: panic: invalid expression token near 'eu'
  at github.com/redwood/runtime/policy.Eval(handlers.go:342)
  at github.com/redwood/runtime/router.route(serve.go:198)
  ...
```

sanjay (oncall-sre): if policy eval panics, router falls back to variant selector which is misconfigured for eu -> ends up thrashing between us-west and eu, causing increased tail latency. Recommend immediate mitigation: disable the policy or revert to previous rule set. Ops console route: https://console.redwood.internal/admin/policies/region_fallback_v2

alice (oncall-ml): understood. I'm going to disable that policy via admin API to stop the fallback loop. Running:```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://admin.internal/api/policies/region_fallback_v2/disable
```

alice (oncall-ml): command executed, got 200 OK: {"policy":"region_fallback_v2","status":"disabled","reason":"emergency-mitigation"}

ops-bot: AUTOMATION: policy region_fallback_v2 set to DISABLED by alice (oncall-ml) at 2026-03-15T09:26:05Z. Triggered rollback rule: disable-fallback-on-panic.

maria (eng-runtime): logs after disable show routing returning to stable default paths, policy-eval panics drop to 0. Sample metric: 5xx rate in EU down from 7.8% -> 1.6% over 4 minutes.

paul (support): starting customer comms: preparing status page update and targeted emails for affected EU customers. ETA for initial message 09:35 UTC.

sanjay (oncall-sre): good mitigation. Need to capture full stacktrace + offending expression for postmortem. Maria, can you dump the policy blob that caused the panic and the input that triggered it?

maria (eng-runtime): grabbing policy and failing input now. Blob name: region_fallback_v2@rev:20260315-482. Offending expression in rule 3: ```region == eu || region in ["eu-west","eu-central"]``` - the parser choked on unquoted token 'eu' when input provided region:"eu-central-1" (string). We likely have inconsistent quoting rules between authoring UI and runtime parser. Full failing input: `{"region":"eu-central-1","model_variant":"gptx-13b-quant"}`.

alice (oncall-ml): noted. I'll add the failing input to the incident record and tag for remediation. For now, mitigation verified. Monitoring shows error rate normalized and no further fallback loops.

paul (support): statuspage draft: "Routing policy runtime error caused degraded responses for customers in EU. Mitigation: policy disabled. No data breach. We will follow up with root cause and ETA for a safe re-deploy." Sending to legal & escalation list for review.

maria (eng-runtime): quick root-cause hypothesis: policy expression grammar mismatch between the web UI (which allowed bare identifiers) and the strict runtime parser expecting quoted strings or a specific enum matcher. We'll need to add stronger validation in the authoring flow and catch panics in eval codepath.

sanjay (oncall-sre): ops followups: (1) revert PR #482 from prod until fix, (2) add try/catch around policy eval to avoid panic causing fallback loops (fallback to a safe default), (3) add integration test with varied region input shapes. I'll create the infra tickets.

alice (oncall-ml): I'm going to page the next shift with a handoff note. Current status: mitigation applied (policy disabled), customer impact reduced, support comms in flight. Handoff to oncall-sre for infra followups and eng-runtime for root cause and fix.

incident-bot: ONCALL HANDOFF: alice (oncall-ml) -> sanjay (oncall-sre) at 2026-03-15T09:40:00Z.

paul (support): tagging postmortem required and scheduling 1-hour incident review 2026-03-15T12:00Z UTC. Assigning owners: maria (eng-runtime) and sanjay (oncall-sre).

alice (oncall-ml): ack and closing this page. I'll update incident doc with commands run and the failing payload. :white_check_mark:
